stem: A coworker wants to remove extra healthy leaves because the canopy will look cleaner. The work order does not call for it. What should the technician do?
choices: Remove them because visual uniformity is always the goal
Follow the defined work order and avoid unnecessary removal
Remove leaves only from the tallest plant
Ask the coworker to decide for the entire room
rationale: Canopy actions should serve a defined production objective, not an aesthetic preference.
